name: Hall of Arms (Northshire)
summary: Recruits train with the Stormwind Army in Northshire Abbey’s Hall of Arms, south of the Main Hall.

sections.title: Groundwork of the Guard
sections.body: Blunted steel rings through the Hall of Arms, and instruction keeps a measured cadence. South of Northshire Abbey’s Main Hall, human fighters and devout aspirants train for the Stormwind Army. Veteran battle instructors and paladin mentors teach the postures and disciplines needed to defend Elwynn Forest from kobolds, Defias bandits, and gnoll raiders. Across the courtyard, clerics and scholars study ancient tomes in the Library Wing.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Hall of Arms?
faq.answer: The Hall of Arms trains new soldiers, mercenaries, and paladins in weapons and combat inside Northshire Abbey, before they venture into the wider kingdom.

faq.q: Who can be found inside this wing?
aliases: who is in hall of arms
faq.answer: Veteran warrior and paladin trainers instruct Stormwind Army recruits in martial disciplines, shield work, and basic combat maneuvers.

faq.q: Where is the Hall of Arms located within Northshire Abbey?
faq.answer: The Hall of Arms lies south of Northshire Abbey’s Main Hall. Across the courtyard stands the Library Wing.

angles.text: As a human warrior entering service, you receive your first lessons here in stance, weapon handling, and the Stormwind Army’s martial discipline.
As a fledgling paladin, you learn to wield the Light alongside martial arms, joining holy devotion with martial training.
